meta.title: Add ExecuteCompiledScriptAction source generator
meta.body_summary: Add a source generator to compile scripts at build time, presumably improving runtime performance for Avalonia XAML Behaviors scripting.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex PR to add a C# source generator; closed by author within a minute, possibly due to invalid test command (dotnet: command not found) or other immediate issues.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 152 changed lines, this is a small edit; closed immediately without any review interaction, indicating a likely pre-merge failure or self-rejection by the author.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal reviews or comments were left on the PR; the author closed it almost instantly.
review_details.performance_claim: Compile scripts at build time to improve runtime performance compared to runtime interpretation.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR was closed by the author 53 seconds after creation with no review activity; the description mentions a failing test command (dotnet: command not found).

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Developing a Roslyn-based source generator for Avalonia XAML Behaviors scripting requires deep .NET ecosystem knowledge; the immediate closure suggests the generated code may not have been viable or the author pre-validated and found issues.

core_change_summary.description: Added a new Roslyn source generator (ExecuteCompiledScriptActionGenerator) under src/Avalonia.Xaml.Interactions.Scripting.Generator/, a runtime action class (ExecuteCompiledScriptAction) under Scripting, a project file, and updated the solution and README.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Solution and README changes integrate the new generator project and document its purpose.
change_trajectory: Single commit (481270c) introducing the source generator, the action class, and associated project infrastructure.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by wieslawsoltes with label 'codex'; no reviews or comments were posted, and the author closed the PR 53 seconds later.
